title: LLM Benchmarking & PoC Acceptance Protocol: AIPerf/GenAI-Perf, vLLM Bench, GuideLLM & Anti-Gaming Trace Replay

workload_assumptions.production_traffic_profile: Poisson/Gamma Burst Arrival + Log-Normal Input/Output + 65% Prefix Share

tiers.name: Tier 1: Naive Identical-Prompt Loop (`wrk/locust` Sending Same String 1,000x -> Accidental 100% Prefix Cache Hit!)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: 100% cache hit skips Prefill compute entirely, over-predicting production capacity by 3.4x!

tiers.name: Tier 2: Fixed-Length Synthetic Tokens (`1024 In / 512 Out` Exact, Constant Arrival, Unconstrained Raw TPS)
tiers.verdict: Misses log-normal long-prompt tail stalls and Poisson arrival bursts (62.4% capacity prediction error)

tiers.name: Tier 3: MLPerf Inference Server Scenario (Audited Poisson Arrival + 99% TTFT/TPOT Constraints)
tiers.verdict: Gold standard for vendor hardware RFP comparison, but uses generic datasets rather than your exact app prefix ratio

tiers.name: Tier 4: AIPerf / GuideLLM / vLLM Trace Replay (Controlled 65% Prefix Tree + Log-Normal Lengths + Dual-SLA Knee Sweep)
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 2.8% PoC-to-Prod prediction error, 0.0% post-launch SLA incidents & automated 48-min Pareto sweep
